title: Haven Homes — Free Bootstrap 6 Real Estate Website Template
excerpt: A free two-page Bootstrap 6 real estate template — split hero with a straddling search panel, property grid with specs, valuation form and a full listing page.
yoastTitle: Haven Homes — Free Bootstrap 6 Real Estate Website Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 real estate template with a split hero, multi-select Combobox property search, Range price filters, Datepicker viewings and a full property detail page.
intro: Haven Homes is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 template for estate agents and property portals. The layout leads with a split hero — copy on one side, a full-height image on the other — and a search panel that straddles the seam between the hero and the page, so search is the first thing in reach rather than an afterthought.
note: Property search is exactly what Bootstrap 6's new form components were built for: a multi-select Combobox for property types, a searchable Combobox for bedrooms, Range sliders with live value bubbles for price, Chip input for must-haves, and the Datepicker for viewings and valuations.
summary: Haven Homes is a free, premium two-page Bootstrap 6 real estate template. A split hero with a straddling search panel, a property grid where each card leads with its specs, a refine drawer built from Range and Chip input, a valuation form with Datepicker, and agent profiles. The property page adds a gallery, tabbed description, room dimensions and a sticky viewing-request rail. ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step.
features: Two pages — search and listings page, plus a full property detail page
Split hero with a search panel straddling the seam into the page
Multi-select Combobox for property type and a Combobox bedroom filter
Refine drawer combining Range price sliders with live bubbles and Chip input must-haves
Property cards that lead with beds, baths and floor area rather than marketing copy
Valuation form with Datepicker and a guide-price Range slider
Property page with gallery, tabbed description, room dimensions and area info
Sticky viewing-request rail with the agent attached
Header is transparent over the hero and turns solid on scroll
Full dark mode via data-bs-theme, remembered across visits
ESM-only vanilla JavaScript — no jQuery, no bundler, no build step
